trust_decision.summary: psql-connect.sh decides whether an agent-supplied --command string is safe to hand to `psql -c`; at the pinned commit it only rejects semicolons and SQL comments, so a backslash-prefixed psql meta-command (incl. the local-shell one) passes to psql.

landing_point.why: The advisory names databases-on-aws and command injection; the only script that passes free-form agent text to a subprocess is psql-connect.sh, and its existing --command sanitizer block is the obvious place.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI: plugins/databases-on-aws/scripts/psql-connect.sh --command/-c SQL (invoked by the agent per plugins/databases-on-aws/skills/dsql/SKILL.md:108-109)
fix_sites.module_kind: CLI wrapper script (single shell script, same file as the sink)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No out-of-scope site exists; the only other psql invocation is the interactive session (plugins/databases-on-aws/scripts/psql-connect.sh:161-167), where meta-commands are the intended behaviour and no agent-supplied command string is passed.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A backslash inside a single-quoted SQL literal (e.g. a LIKE escape or regex in a WHERE clause) must still be accepted, and the interactive no-command session must keep allowing meta-commands; a blanket reject of any backslash in COMMAND breaks the first.

O6_input_shapes: backslash-prefixed meta-command outside single-quoted literals (any meta-command name, not only the shell one)
backslash inside a single-quoted literal is stripped first and allowed (fix.diff:66)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second option (e.g. a --file/--query-file or a variable-setting option) whose value is passed to psql without the --command sanitizer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The argument parser already forwards several values to psql; a maintainer adding a file-based query option for longer SQL (the comment at :140 already steers complex queries elsewhere) would plausibly skip the --command block.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a post-load verification step that runs a psql query built from --table
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: loader.sh already builds the DSQL endpoint the same way as psql-connect.sh (:377 vs psql-connect.sh:100); a row-count check via psql after loading would be a natural addition and would sit in another file from the landing point.

O9_family: OS command injection via an incomplete denylist (CWE-184): interpreter meta-command reaching a local-shell escape through a CLI wrapper

O10_build.toolchain: bash, sed, grep; repo build via mise (uv, node 24) per mise.toml:12-23; tests via `uv run --with pytest pytest tools plugins` (mise.toml:118)
services: psql client and aws CLI on PATH (both stubbable for tests; the check runs before psql is invoked)
O10_build.project_tests: None for psql-connect.sh at the pinned commit; the fix diff adds none either. Behavioural tests would need stub `aws`/`psql` executables on PATH.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject only the shell-escape meta-command (backslash-bang) or any backslash anywhere in COMMAND, missing the other meta-commands or breaking backslashes inside SQL literals.

out_of_scope_notes: psql reads a startup file (psqlrc / PSQLRC env) before -c unless -X is passed; environment-controlled, not this advisory's input.
tools/evals/databases-on-aws/dsql/scripts/run_query_explainability_evals.py:156-169 only pattern-matches psql commands in eval transcripts; not a sink.
Skill docs steer the agent to psql-connect.sh (plugins/databases-on-aws/skills/dsql/SKILL.md:108-109); an agent invoking psql directly is agent behaviour, not code in scope.
unverified: Assumed from psql behaviour (not in this repo): in -c mode psql treats the string as a meta-command only when its first character is a backslash, otherwise it sends the whole string to the server; if so, quote-stripping differentials (double-quoted identifiers, E'' escapes, dollar quotes) give no how-type room against the fixed check.
repo_mb not measured (no shell used); candidate metadata flags a compact small repo, so tiny_repo likely holds but was not confirmed.
present_in_latest not applicable: latest release is none and O8 is empty.
